context: oya-shared-connector-kernel + 10 first-wave adapters landed on branch oya-microservice-flat-layout-buildout-2026-05-17. The 11 crates compile and test green in isolation. The list below is parent-coordinator-scoped follow-up wiring required to surface them into the rest of the platform.

todos.detail: Add slack, teams, workday, adp, rippling, gusto, salesforce, netsuite, quickbooks, epic-fhir as connector providers under capabilities.connectors.

todos.summary: Wire OntologyProjection consumer in oya-ontology-* µservice
todos.detail: Ontology µservice must subscribe to projections published by each adapter — Employee from Workday/ADP/Rippling/Gusto, Customer from Salesforce/NetSuite/QBO, Patient/Encounter/Observation from Epic FHIR. Track under oya-check-ontology-projection-coverage.

todos.summary: Register adapter SecretReference paths in OpenBao policy template
todos.detail: Each tenant's OpenBao instance needs KV-v2 paths under sref://<tenant>/<provider>/* per README. Template the bao policy file in infra/secrets-templates.

todos.summary: Wire RateLimitDescriptor into the per-tenant scheduler
todos.detail: Caller-side scheduler (workflow µservice) must consume RateLimitDescriptor::requests_per_second + burst_capacity per (tenant, provider) and budget.

todos.summary: Promote Cedar policy templates into oya-policy-cedar fragment registry
todos.detail: Each adapter ships a starter Cedar policy at specs/cedar-policy.cedar. The parent µservice oya-policy-cedar must ingest these as default fragments and surface them in the per-tenant policy bundle.

todos.summary: Add live-network feature flag and reqwest-based adapter sibling
todos.detail: Each adapter currently uses an in-memory sandbox-shaped store. The follow-up IP adds a `live-network` feature that swaps the Mutex<Store> for a reqwest-backed client. The trait contract stays the same.
Per ADR-0130/0131 agentic SLO-gated promotion, the connector substrate must publish SLOs (call latency p99 ≤ rate-limit-decided budget; audit-seal coverage = 100%) before promotion past dev.

todos.summary: Author ADR for Connector trait stability and capability declarations
todos.detail: Document the contract under docs/decisions/ADR-NNNN-connector-substrate.md citing this batch report.

todos.summary: Wire oya-check-audit-chain-seal-coverage and oya-check-ontology-projection-coverage to include connector adapters
todos.detail: Both checks should scan crates/oya-connector-*-adapter/ and assert (a) every Connector method calls audit_handle().seal(), and (b) every adapter declares OntologyProjection (default empty is acceptable for write-only adapters).

todos.summary: Document HL7v2 fallback adapter as a follow-up IP
todos.detail: Epic-FHIR README references an HL7v2 fallback. Register `oya-connector-hl7v2-adapter` as a planned crate in the workspace metadata for tenants on legacy interfaces.
